content.comment_body: I'm interested in controlling workholding on a CNC mill using a [product_name] unit. The control system runs on [product_name] V4.04. I know that [product_name] can communicate with [product_name] PLCs, but I'm unsure how to configure the control system to enable this. Because there are limited available hardwired IOs, I'd prefer to use Ethernet or Profinet for communication. Thank you for any advice.

[product_name] is unable to interface directly with a CNC system in the same way as a [product_name] PLC. However, it can communicate with [product_name] PLCs via Ethernet TCP/IP using the appropriate protocol.
Apologies, I meant communicating not directly with the CNC, but with the [product_name] PLC that is integrated into the control unit.
Can the [product_name] PLC support Ethernet TCP/IP? Note: [product_name] cannot use PPI, MPI, or Profibus. It is only compatible with Ethernet TCP/IP using the relevant protocol and/or Modbus TCP/IP.
I understand that to finalize communication, the [product_name] PLC needs to be configured to recognize the [product_name]'s IP address. I’m uncertain how to set this up on the [version_no].

There may not be any official compatibility testing at [company_name] for using [product_name] with this CNC system. Still, if you utilize [product_name] protocol communication with the CNC system, it should operate similarly to how it does with other PLCs. It’s worth trying it out.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are discussing how to enable communication between a [product_name] controller and a CNC control system featuring an integrated [product_name] PLC. They mainly seek solutions for Ethernet or Profinet connections due to limited hardwired IO availability. Uncertainty exists regarding supported protocols and specific configuration steps, such as setting up device recognition via IP address and ensuring system compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect straightforward instructions on configuring Ethernet-based connectivity between [product_name] and the integrated [product_name] PLC within the control system, including clear and practical step-by-step guidance.
